* Body

Mira was running load tests against the checkout preview environment when she noticed intermittent 401s under burst traffic. The logs showed JWT verification failures that recovered spontaneously, suggesting a race between token expiry and the validation cache. She documented the pattern and flagged it as a blocking issue for the upcoming auth refactor. This discovery kicked off the six-day arc.
